Personal goals for 2026:

- Run a half marathon by the end of summer; build mileage gradually with a structured training plan.
- Read at least twenty books this year, mixing fiction, history, and technical material.
- Launch a side project on knowledge management that integrates note-taking with graph visualisation.
- Learn conversational Spanish through weekly tutoring sessions and daily flashcard practice.
- Save twenty percent of income each month into a long-term index fund portfolio.
- Cook at home four nights a week to improve nutrition and reduce eating-out expenses.
- Travel to two new countries, prioritising places I have never visited before.
